lead.headline: Love says it's a sore back — Friday still decides
lead.deck: Jefferson says the ankle is better every day; both fallbacks stay armed for Friday's reports.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Jordan Love and Justin Jefferson are both still limited — Wednesday's report is the only one out. Love called it 'a sore back from the game' and shook off the idea of missing Detroit (Packers Wire 22 Oct); Jefferson says the ankle is 'feeling better and better every single day' (AP via JOX 22 Oct). Neither has a backup who can execute on Sunday — Josh Allen is on bye and DK Metcalf plays in Paris at 07:30 — so both calls stay on Friday's reports: if Love is still designated, add Matthew Stafford (a free agent now, kicks off with Love) and drop Alvin Kamara; if Jefferson is doubtful or out, start Metcalf. ESPN has AVIATO 63%, 130.8 to 105.5.

doFirst.empty: Nothing to fire this Thursday morning — Love and Jefferson are decided by Friday's reports.
